name: FedPac Insurance
verdict: Brand of the Federal Pacific Insurance group, which says its companies are privately owned (founder Alistair Hutchison, chairman Papalii Alan Hutchison). Nothing found.
note: Front sponsor of Manu Samoa's 2026 home jersey and Lakapi Samoa's major sponsor from May 2026 (SAT$3m over two years, Samoa Observer 8 May 2026). Rated none in the rugby-samoa sweep (issue #725): the group states its companies are privately owned; named individuals per its own site and Cook Islands News (federal-pacific-group-ownership). No state shareholder identified; no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding identified.
